findings.title: Client Astana bbox is narrower than R02's, so valid published geometry is dropped and labelled 'lon/lat swapped'
findings.how: ASTANA_BBOX = R02 envelope [70.8,50.75,72.1,51.6]; swap hint only if the swapped shape lands inside; out-of-region counted apart from missing coordinates

findings.title: Period filter semantics differ from contract §2 / R02 _filter_sql, and excluded incomplete intervals are not reported
findings.how: plannedInterval uses current_planned_end only; open unknown bound like R02 _filter_sql, flagged 'Начало/Окончание неизвестно'; one-sided custom period no longer throws
findings.regression_check: core: period rule; browser: custom period with only an end date

findings.title: Card ties the status to updated_at ('Идут работы по данным на …'), implying it was verified at publication time
findings.how: 'по данным на' replaced by 'запись обновлена …'; 'статус по источнику от <published_on>' only when a source covers the status field

findings.title: Real R02 timestamps are always shown in UTC as 'UTC+0'; times are 5 h off Astana and the day can be wrong
findings.how: timestamps with an offset are converted to Astana time from the instant (UTC+6 before 2024-02-29T18:00Z, UTC+5 after), labelled '(время Астаны)'

findings.title: Undated note, chip counts and 'Без координат' ignore the active kind/area/search filters, so they claim more than the action yields
findings.how: applyFilters takes the search predicate; undated/facets/'без координат' count only records passing the other filters

findings.title: refresh() swaps the open card's item for the list copy without refreshing history, and keeps showing objects that are no longer published
findings.how: refresh re-reads GET /objects/{id} when the revision changed or the object left the list

findings.title: Demo marker on map points is a solid thin grey ring, not the dashed ring the legend promises, and resembles the 'status unknown' ring
findings.how: synthetic points get a canvas-drawn dashed ring (symbol layer civic-r03-point-synthetic + image civic-r03-demo-ring, removed in destroy)

findings.title: Ungrammatical or unagreed Russian strings in the period note, truncation note and evidence banner
findings.how: period note, truncation plural and evidence banner rewritten

findings.title: One malformed record throws in normalizeObject, so the whole list fails and the user is told there is no network
findings.how: enumOf for every enum, safe schema_version, loop flattening, per-record try/catch, TypeError no longer reported as offline, safe valueText, renderCard in try/finally

findings.title: A second mount on the same map and root leaves an empty root, and destroying it puts back the old instance's dead UI
findings.how: mount destroys any instance bound to the same root or map before capturing the root (byRoot/byMap)
findings.regression_check: browser: second mount on same root

findings.title: Typing in search filters the list but never updates the map source, so list and map disagree
findings.how: search debounced 150 ms, updates map source, active-filter count and reset; Enter applies at once

findings.title: After refresh, a selected object that is no longer published still shows as a normal 'ready' card
findings.how: same change as r03-refresh-card-sync

findings.title: Map hit-test picks the topmost polygon, so a small polygon inside a larger one can never be selected or hovered
findings.how: hit-test prefers the smallest polygon; feature collection draws large polygons first

findings.title: Mobile overlay: the first selection from 'peek' measures camera padding before the sheet finishes growing, so the object lands under the sheet
findings.how: onSelect before camera; camera waits 320 ms for the sheet transition on phones (none with reduced motion)
findings.regression_check: browser phone-tap tests wait for the sheet; list selection from peek is not separately asserted

findings.title: Re-selecting the already-open object fires onSelect again and refetches; in the R01 shell this destroys an open feedback form
findings.how: same id from map/list while ready/loading does not refetch or re-fire onSelect
findings.regression_check: browser: tapping the open object again

findings.title: Every search keystroke rebuilds and re-sorts the whole list synchronously, with no debounce
findings.how: debounce, cached normalised search text, items sorted once per load, list capped at 200 with 'Показать ещё'
findings.regression_check: performance: debounce exercised by search tests, no timing assertion

findings.title: Activating reset, retry or show-undated drops keyboard focus to <body>
findings.how: focus moves to a stable control when the activated one disappears; area-filter re-render keeps focus in the panel

findings.title: role=alert error and empty-state messages are re-inserted on every keystroke and filter change
findings.how: status region rebuilt only when its state key changes; no role=alert inside the polite region
findings.regression_check: browser: error not re-inserted per keystroke

findings.title: Map marks demo points with a solid grey ring that the legend calls dashed, and the selection ring hides it
findings.how: dashed ring image matches the legend; selection ring moved outside it (r 17.5)

findings.title: On mobile, tapping a map object expands the sheet over it without moving the camera
findings.how: map-sourced selection pans the object into the free area after the sheet grows; pass 2: a map tap now actually pans (onMapClick no longer passes fly:false), phone padding defaults
findings.regression_check: browser: phone tap 390x844 and 667x375 (fixed in pass 2; the pass-1 fix was incomplete)

findings.title: Overlay bottom sheet covers the map tools, including the 3D toggle, on short or landscape phones in every sheet state
findings.how: short/landscape phones: sheet leaves a 62px right column for the map tools; peek height min(158px,40vh)

findings.title: "Только видимая часть карты" lists objects hidden under the panel or bottom sheet
findings.how: visible part = canvas minus panel/sheet (unprojected free rectangle)
findings.regression_check: browser: 'visible part' excludes objects under the panel

findings.title: In the mobile peek state, Tab moves focus into a ~14px clipped strip and scrolls the overflow:hidden sheet
findings.how: focus entering the peeking sheet opens it to half; overlay root overflow: clip
findings.regression_check: browser: keyboard Tab into peek opens the sheet

findings.title: Search, select, date and chip boundaries are about 1.4:1 against their background
findings.how: field/chip/grip outlines #7c8881 (3.69:1 on #fff, 3.46:1 on #f7f8f4)

findings.title: Sheet handle says "Развернуть панель" while aria-expanded is true
findings.how: label names the next action; aria-expanded only in full; aria-controls -> scroll region
findings.regression_check: browser: sheet handle names the next action

review_2.workflow: wf_a7151be5-5e0 (2 regression hunters + completeness critic, each with an adversarial verifier) on 1c75a96, plus R01 MATRIX defect R01-F-R03-1

findings.title: Tapping an object on the map never runs ensureVisible, so the mobile-tap-hides-selected fix has no effect and its regression test is flaky
findings.how: onMapClick selects with source 'map' (no fly:false) so ensureVisible pans after the sheet settles; phone padding defaults (top 84, right 60)
findings.regression_check: browser: phone tap 390x844 + 667x375 (wait for sheet, camera moved)

findings.title: New focusin->half handler pops a collapsed mobile sheet back open whenever the module restores focus after a re-render
findings.how: all module focus moves go through focusEl(); focusin opens a peeking sheet only for user keyboard focus (:focus-visible) and never during the module's own focus restore
findings.regression_check: browser: own focus restores never reopen a collapsed sheet; keyboard does

findings.title: applyFilters now counts outsideArea/noGeometry before the period check, so these counters overstate what unchecking the area filter would show
findings.how: period checked before area counters

findings.title: If the re-read of a changed revision fails after refresh, the card keeps the old revision while the list and map show the new one, and claims 'Показаны сведения из списка'
findings.how: refresh re-read error falls back to the fresh list copy and drops the old history
findings.regression_check: browser: failed re-read shows the fresh list copy

findings.title: featureCollection's comparator returns 0 for mixed geometry pairs, so large polygons are not reliably drawn before small ones
findings.how: polygons partitioned and sorted by area, then other geometry
findings.regression_check: core: draw order with a point in between

findings.title: Re-adding the new demo-ring symbol layer from the styledata handler makes MapLibre throw in placement after a diff setStyle
findings.how: styledata re-add deferred to requestAnimationFrame, cancelled on destroy
findings.regression_check: browser: host setStyle (diff) without placement errors

findings.title: The status refactor makes error/refreshing states and the 'ничего не найдено' message mutually exclusive
findings.how: status region key combines error/refreshing with 'nothing found'; both blocks shown
findings.regression_check: browser: stale-data error keeps count and reset

findings.title: Peek sheet bounces back to half when a re-render puts focus back inside the scroller
findings.how: same as focusin-reopens-collapsed-sheet
findings.regression_check: browser: own focus restores never reopen a collapsed sheet

findings.title: Phone map tap never moves the camera; the tapped object stays under the sheet and its regression test passes by accident
findings.how: same as map-tap-never-pans

findings.title: Tapping the already-open object while the sheet peeks no longer brings its card up
findings.how: re-tap of the open object opens a peeking sheet to half and focuses the card, still without refetch/onSelect
findings.regression_check: browser: re-tapping while the sheet peeks

findings.title: Stale-data error state: count stops updating and the 'nothing found' message with its reset button is gone
findings.how: error state keeps 'Показано N из M · прежние данные' and the 'nothing found' reset
findings.regression_check: browser: stale-data error keeps count and reset

findings.title: Rewritten truncation note still has a Russian agreement error for counts ending in 1
findings.how: notes rephrased without participle agreement ('Записей загружено: N', 'Без плановых дат: N (в выбранный период не входят)')

findings.title: DELIVERY.json code_commit is the pre-fix commit 9cb1a2e, and INTEGRATION.txt tells R01 to import exactly that SHA
findings.how: DELIVERY code_commit = 3cea09c (all fixes); INTEGRATION §0 names it

findings.title: On a phone, selecting an object by tapping the map never moves the camera, so the object ends up under the half sheet. The review fix does not work, and its regression test measures before the sheet finishes moving
findings.how: same as map-tap-never-pans

findings.title: DELIVERY.json and STATUS.md still say R01 has not imported R03 and that only a mock was used, which contradicts INTEGRATION.txt §0 and the committed R01 run
findings.how: DELIVERY/STATUS record R01's integration and the R01 P0 runs on 8c6add9 and final 5c47a85

findings.title: The historical-plan mark only looks at current_planned_end, so old plans whose only end date is original_planned_end, or that only have a years-old start, are no longer marked (a regression from 9cb1a2e)
findings.how: staleness uses current end, else the original end (new end not published), else a start older than a year with no end; distinct banner texts

findings.title: "25 fixed with regression checks" is overstated: several of the cited checks also pass on the pre-fix code, or are manual only
findings.how: each finding now states whether its automated check fails on the pre-fix code (measured by running the current tests against 9cb1a2e and 1bc9c48 module files)

findings.title: "A small polygon is drawn above a large one" only holds when the two polygons are next to each other, because the sort comparator is inconsistent
findings.how: same as feature-sort-not-transitive

findings.title: Lines (and mostly areas) do not show status, but the brief asks for colour/shape by kind and status
findings.how: lines: planned/unknown hollow (white core layer civic-r03-line-core), in progress solid, completed thin/pale, cancelled grey; areas: planned/unknown without fill, in progress filled; legend section 'Линии и участки — статус'
findings.regression_check: browser: lines and areas show status

findings.title: The brief asks DELIVERY to list the JS/CSS import order and events, but DELIVERY.json only holds a file path
findings.how: DELIVERY integration_notes lists CSS/JS order and events

findings.title: Primary card button text had the colour of its dark background in the integrated build
findings.how: resets moved under :where() (zero class weight); button colours and font sizes now come from their own classes; R01's shell.css adapter is no longer needed (R01 P0 flow passes with the adapter removed)
findings.regression_check: browser: buttons keep their own colours

method: Discriminating = the current test file fails when only web/civic/map is replaced by the old commit's files (scratch worktrees, same tests and stand).
